prompt: Create an authoritative digital journalism platform for The Meridian Chronicle based on evals/fixtures/visual-quality/news-brief.json. Provide 4 page roles (Home Broadsheet, Article Reading View, Sections Archive, Membership Support). Emphasize high-legibility editorial typography, scannable news hierarchy, immersive distraction-free reading, and strict avoidance of clickbait ad layouts.
expected_outcomes: Multi-column editorial broadsheet layout with clear lead story dominance on Home
Article page optimized for long-form reading comfort (proper line-length, dropcaps, pull-quotes, margin notes)
Photojournalism captions and provenance credits clearly rendered
Mobile reading experience is distraction-free with intuitive font size and reading progress indicators
Deterministic visual gates pass with clean valid HTML
must_not: Render clickbait badges, flashing ads, or intrusive modal overlays
Give equal visual prominence to lead investigative reporting and minor briefs
Use low-contrast grey body text for long-form article prose
Produce identical 3-card rows across home and article pages
